entries.098dc51abc6435d6: Its management policy is to aim to be a “comprehensive manufacturer of power transmission and conveying” that contributes to industries in Japan and overseas through the manufacture and sale of various chains, mainly power transmission roller chains, and sprockets. Under the 8th Medium-Term Management Plan for fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028, its manufacturing strategy aims for a quality and supply system ranked No.1 in the world in the large-chain field, and it will seek to improve productivity and optimize costs by operating a new production management system introduced in March 2026. As its sales strategy, it cites deepening the four-company business alliance concluded in December 2025 and strengthening its overseas sales network.
